cues: Suppose it weighs zero point two three three gram.
A mole of barium sulphate, two hundred and thirty three grams, contains ninety six grams of sulphate.
So simple proportion gives zero point zero nine six gram of sulphate.
Chloride is weighed the same way as silver chloride, and iron as iron three oxide.
